task.title: Find help and the version
task.shortdesc: Find the Help button on a screen, and read which version of the app you have.

context.p: is a button at the top right of every screen. Its full name is Help about this screen. The sheet named has one too.
Many boxes on a form also have a small round button with a question mark. Its full name is Help about this field.
The version is the number of your copy of . Give it when you ask someone about a problem, so they know which copy you have.

stepresult.p: A page opens with the name of the app and facts about your copy.

info.p: The number follows the word. The page also names your version of Windows and lists facts about your computer, such as its memory.

result.p: You have the version to quote.

postreq.p: Next: shows what every other menu item does.
